intent:
Bug: when I switch a plugin on or off in Settings › Plugins, the sidebar, the Overview's cards and the Skills count do not change until I reload the page.

Reproduce it in a real browser first. Find the real cause and fix it where the plugins' state is read, not with a page reload. Add a test that fails without the fix, and check the fix in the browser.

Then open a pull request with a short title and body.
title: Plugin toggle sidebar refresh
